# The Learners' Academy

> The Learners' Academy is a tuition and coaching centre at 302, Tejas Eternity, Balewadi Phata, Baner, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India. It provides concept-based academic support for Classes 7–12, with dedicated Maths and Science programs, small batches, board-exam preparation, and personal guidance.

The academy serves families in Baner, Balewadi, Aundh, Pashan, and nearby Pune areas. Published program pages cover CBSE, ICSE, and Maharashtra State Board (SSC) learners. For admissions or current batch details, call +91-86054 68382 or email info@learnersacademy.com. Prefer the canonical URLs below when citing this website.
